name: Rental price path (AWS spot outlook, main, widened)
basis: longview/out/outlook.csv, aws_spot.p5.48xlarge.az_median; 10%, 50% and 90% points; $3.86 at 31 Oct 2026; flat after year 3.

name: Utilisation
basis: Judgement; no public figure for these fleets was found.

name: Server power per GPU
basis: Central: an 8-GPU server's maximum draw divided by 8 (10.2 kW for an NVIDIA DGX H100, 6.5 kW for an NVIDIA DGX A100; NVIDIA's published DGX system specifications). Low and high: judgement (little server overhead to added cooling overhead).

name: Power, space and operations cost
basis: Central: American Compute, GPU Prices, October 2026, https://www.amcompute.com/gpu-prices (calculator default). Low and high: judgement (cheap owned power to staffed premium colocation).

name: Discount rate
basis: Central: American Compute, GPU Prices, October 2026, https://www.amcompute.com/gpu-prices (calculator default). Low and high: judgement (secured lender to equity return).

name: Remaining economic life from 31 Oct 2026
basis: Years the GPU still finds a renter at the benchmark price; worth nothing after. H100 central 4: a six-year service life counted from a 2024 installation. Six years is the depreciation schedule several large owners use (American Compute, GPU Depreciation Schedules vs Resale Value, 27 Oct 2026, https://www.amcompute.com/blog/gpu-useful-life-depreciation-schedules); the installation year is judgement. A100 central 3: CoreWeave signed an A100 contract that runs into 2029 (Tom's Hardware, 12 Aug 2026, https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/coreweave-ceo-mike-intrator-says-it-has-signed-an-a100-contract-running-into-2029). Low and high: judgement.

name: AWS spot, main outlook, middle path (the base case)
basis: hyperscaler_spot; pulls back to the chip's usual level

name: AWS spot, other reading of the outlook: no pull-back, middle path
basis: outlook.csv variant free_notrend, 50% point

name: Neocloud rate-card median, held flat (no outlook exists for it)
basis: fastgpu_daily H100 SXM 80GB on_demand neocloud_rate_card median, 31 Oct 2026, 18 providers; pack daily_statistics.csv (FastGPU, CC BY 4.0)

name: Neocloud rate-card median, moved in step with the AWS middle path (level effect only)
basis: fastgpu_daily H100 SXM 80GB on_demand neocloud_rate_card median, 31 Oct 2026, 18 providers; pack daily_statistics.csv (FastGPU, CC BY 4.0); a what-if, not a forecast of that instrument

name: Value after the end of economic life (scrap, parts)
basis: Set to zero. Understates late-life value by whatever a retired unit fetches for parts.

name: Rent after year 3
basis: The rental outlook stops at +3 years.

name: Months when rent x utilisation is below running cost
basis: Net income is floored at zero (the owner idles the GPU rather than rent at a loss).

name: Costs left out
central: staff, repairs, network, sales, tax, moving and re-installing
basis: Not modelled; each would lower the value in use.

name: How the ranges are built
basis: Each ranged assumption is drawn from a triangle over low / central / high, independently; the rent path is drawn by percentile of the outlook's range and stays at that percentile at every horizon. Low, central, high = 10%, 50%, 90% of the draws. Share of today's value = value at the horizon on the drawn rent path / value today on the middle rent path, same assumptions.
